README.md:
# Your lab

Review plan.json and the Ansible roles before applying.
Publish this repository at the Git URL in the plan before applying Argo CD.
Run bromigos lab provision apply --repo <this-folder> to converge again.
Removing a service from the selection leaves its data and running resources in place.
ansible/ansible.cfg:
[defaults]
roles_path = roles
host_key_checking = True
retry_files_enabled = False
ansible/roles/agents/tasks/main.json:
[
  {
    "ansible.builtin.command": {
      "argv": [
        "helm",
        "status",
        "lab-agents",
        "-n",
        "lab-agents",
        "-o",
        "json",
        "--kubeconfig",
        "/tmp/example-kubeconfig",
        "--kube-context",
        "example"
      ]
    },
    "changed_when": false,
    "failed_when": false,
    "name": "Read agents release ownership",
    "register": "agent_release"
  },
  {
    "ansible.builtin.assert": {
      "that": [
        "agent_release.rc != 0 or (agent_release.stdout | from_json).info.description == 'bromigos-lab-provision'"
      ]
    },
    "name": "Check agents ownership"
  },
  {
    "ansible.builtin.command": {
      "argv": [
        "helm",
        "upgrade",
        "--install",
        "lab-agents",
        "{{ playbook_dir }}/../../helm/agents",
        "--namespace",
        "lab-agents",
        "--create-namespace",
        "--description",
        "bromigos-lab-provision",
        "--kubeconfig",
        "/tmp/example-kubeconfig",
        "--kube-context",
        "example",
        "--wait",
        "--timeout",
        "10m",
        "--values",
        "{{ playbook_dir }}/../../helm/hermes/values.yaml",
        "--values",
        "{{ playbook_dir }}/../../helm/openclaw/values.yaml"
      ]
    },
    "changed_when": false,
    "name": "Converge agents"
  }
]
